_comment: Search partitions for discovery. Two things matter here and both were
learned the hard way from eBay's API behaviour:
1. buyingOptions is set explicitly on every partition. Browse returns
FIXED_PRICE only by default, so omitting it silently produces a
Buy-It-Now-only dataset - the exact bias this tool measures.
2. Sovereigns live in TWO category subtrees (UK gold coins AND the
bullion subtree). Category ids below are placeholders until the
EBAY_GB tree is enumerated via the Taxonomy API - run
'coin-market categories' to fill them in for the UK site.
